description: This source file defines utilities and helpers for debugging voice wake recognition, including transcript logging, fallback matching, and summary generation within a voice recognition context.

methods.name: shouldLogTranscript
methods.description: Determines if a transcript should be logged based on its content, log level, and timing restrictions.

methods.name: textOnlyFallbackMatch
methods.description: Attempts to generate a fallback command from a transcript if it matches certain criteria.

methods.name: transcriptSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary of the transcript, indicating if it's text-only and the number of segments.

methods.name: matchSummary
methods.description: Provides a string summary of a wake word match if present.
